**8B.2 Research Note**
**Verdict:** Yes. In 2024 Xi’s program was translated into concrete budgets, sectoral plans, institutional changes, and enforcement mechanisms. The main limitation is that most of it ran through Party control, with weak transparency and little independent oversight.

**Concrete implementation**
| Title | Publisher | Date | URL | Claim-level summary | QIDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| `Budget raises central transfers for equal basic public services` | english.www.gov.cn / Xinhua | 2024-03-14 | https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202403/14/content_WS65f2f558c6d0868f4e8e5166.html | Beijing increased central transfers for education, social insurance, employment, and public health. This is a concrete budget channel, not just slogan-level strategy. | 8B.2 |
| `Finance ministry pushes broad-based growth agenda` | english.www.gov.cn / Xinhua | 2024-03-25 | https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202403/25/content_WS6600afebc6d0868f4e8e569e.html | Sets specific priorities: equipment renewal, consumer trade-ins, fair treatment in tax relief and procurement, plus spending on education, healthcare, social security, and environment. | 8B.2, 7B.9 |
| `NDRC says it will keep helping private enterprises and use feedback` | english.news.cn / Xinhua | 2024-01-10 | https://english.news.cn/20240110/78198229d70d4ad2824f8b50c3bedeee/c.html | Gives a concrete policy feedback loop for private firms and entrepreneurs, showing program-to-administration translation rather than pure patronage. | 8B.2, 7B.9 |
| `PBOC says it will keep policy flexible, moderate, precise and effective` | Reuters | 2024-02-08 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy/chinas-central-bank-to-keep-policy-support-for-economy-3297311 | The central bank publicly committed to price stability, liquidity support, and recovery management, which is a real macro-policy mechanism. | 8B.2 |
| `China unveils new property support measures` | Reuters | 2024-01-31 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/china-unveils-new-property-support-measures-amid-concerns-about-evergrande-fallout-3287774 | Concrete housing intervention: downpayment and mortgage-floor cuts, SOE purchases of unsold homes, and project-completion financing. | 8B.2 |
| `Health reform package with procurement, DRG/DI, and wage reform` | english.www.gov.cn / Xinhua | 2024-06-06 | https://english.www.gov.cn/policies/latestreleases/202406/06/content_WS66619f69c6d0868f4e8e7e08.html | Specifies institutional tools for health governance: fee reform, centralized drug procurement with supervision, DRG/DI payment reform, wage reform, and support to基层 services. | 8B.2, 7B.9 |
| `Procurement plan targets bid-rigging and unequal treatment` | english.www.gov.cn / Xinhua | 2024-07-04 | https://english.www.gov.cn/policies/latestreleases/202407/04/content_WS66866f3cc6d0868f4e8e8dc1.html | Sets a rule-based procurement framework with equal participation across ownership types, anti-bid-rigging enforcement, and a unified market. | 8B.2, 7B.9 |
| `Xi’s discipline campaign and elite expulsions` | Xinhua / english.www.gov.cn | 2024-05-26 | https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202405/26/content_WS66533ca6c6d0868f4e8e77c0.html | The campaign framed cadres as “loyal, clean and responsible,” and was followed by concrete punishment of senior figures such as Li Shangfu. This is an enforcement mechanism, though it is internal Party discipline rather than independent accountability. | 8B.2, 7B.10 |

**Limits / counterevidence**
| Title | Publisher | Date | URL | Claim-level summary | QIDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| `State Council law gives Party more control over the cabinet` | Reuters | 2024-03-11 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/china-passes-law-granting-communist-party-more-control-over-cabinet-3331891 | Implementation ran through tighter Party capture of state administration, not autonomous institutions. That makes the program concrete, but politically centralized. | 8B.2, 8B.1 |
| `Premier press conference canceled` | Reuters | 2024-03-04 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy/china-cancels-premiers-press-conference-for-first-time-since-1993-3322647 | One of the few recurring public accountability venues was removed, weakening transparent feedback and public scrutiny of execution. | 8B.2, 7B.10 |
| `Party-led anti-graft committee in finance` | Reuters / MarketScreener | 2024-07-24 | https://hk.marketscreener.com/news/latest/China-targets-financial-sector-with-party-led-anti-graft-committee-47453350/ | Finance was put under “political supervision” and “party building,” so enforcement existed, but it was loyalty- and control-heavy rather than independently rule-bound. | 8B.2, 7B.9, 7B.10 |
| `Radio Free Asia closes Hong Kong bureau after Article 23` | Reuters | 2024-03-29 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/usfunded-radio-free-asia-shuts-hong-kong-bureau-citing-security-law-concerns-3358157 | Independent reporting was chilled enough to close a bureau, which undercuts any claim that execution was being publicly verified in a healthy information environment. | 8B.2, 7B.10 |

**Search gap**
- I found strong evidence of plans, budgets, institutions, appointments, and enforcement.
- I did not find credible 2024 evidence of independent evaluation, open scorecards, or genuinely depoliticized oversight of these programs.
- So the best-supported reading is not “no implementation,” but “implementation by centralized Party-state mechanisms, with limited transparency and weak independent checks.”
